notes.pro_rata_share: GSA full-building lease. Government is sole tenant paying 100% of operating costs via the Shell Rent / Operating Cost Escalation structure.
notes.cap_type: GSA leases use CPI-based annual escalation on the operating cost component of rent, not a traditional cap. The CPI adjustment is a floor/ceiling mechanism, not a cap on actual expenses. Classified as 'none' since there is no cap on actual pass-through costs.
notes.admin_fee_percent: GSA standard lease forms do not include management/admin fees as a separate pass-through. Operating costs are built into the shell rent structure.
notes.excluded_pools: Capital improvements and alterations are excluded from operating costs under GSA General Clauses (3517B). Government handles its own tenant improvements via separate TI allowance.
notes.accounting_basis: Inferred from GSA's federal accounting standards (accrual basis per OMB Circular A-136)
